paint_verification.sample_set: 25 interior grid points per current Landscape component plus six manager-owned source-derived known road/pad points per area
paint_verification.readiness: paint_ready requires finite normalized four-target weights (4/255 tolerance), all four roles nonzero in samples, no zero/failure samples, no known-location role mismatch. Narrow target absence is unresolved sampled evidence, not proof of an empty weightmap. Known RoadBed and BuildingPad probes must explicitly pass; grid-only output cannot pass. Missing or duplicate/nonfinite probes fail closed before preparation/readiness.
paint_verification.postprocessing: Zero readback is recorded as pending. Keep existing bounded retry after completed Bake and before old actor retirement/named result saves. Do not use ground_paint_weight_observed alone.
paint_verification.known_points: PROFILE_PATCHES.json includes exact world cm and source receipt hashes. Road/pad minimum target weight 0.8; Ground therefore <= about 0.2 at those test points, not a claim of exact zero at partial boundaries.
paint_verification.ground_steep_locations: Use role_weight_readback.Ground.best_sample and .Steep.best_sample from the actual normalized native readback; save those exact locations/weights as new receipts. Prefer near Ground >0.8 and Steep >0.8. If sparse grid misses steep, task4 reports coordinates from a known actual steep location and manager supplies extra profile probe; no gate relaxation or upstream change.
paint_verification.full_exclusion: At full road/pad/steep weight ~1 the Ground grass input must be ~0. Fractional slope/boundary weights reduce Grass proportionally.
paint_verification.geographic_semantics: Sand_01 is geometric Ground; not new land-cover classification or surveyed vegetation.

near_view_acceptance: After complete ordinary operation and shader/paint readiness, use a Ground best_sample inside the actual geographic area (not merely the outer terrain margin). Place camera about 200-400 cm above local ground, within 50 m; record actual camera transform and Lit viewport mode.

Record current grass.Enable, grass.DensityScale, grass.CullDistanceScale, grass quality/per-quality mode and foliage scalability using supported read-only console queries; zero/disabled explains absence but does not pass visibility. Do not force cache via a separate pilot.

Allow normal native grass streaming/update to settle. Call inspect_near_view(run, current_landscape, actual_camera_location_cm, radius_cm=5000) through the activated task4 run/guard context. Capture existing world instance positions. One nearby cached instance is separate from a Lit screenshot with visible permitted grass and textured ground.

Inspect both permitted mesh varieties in suitable near views where available; record missing variety explicitly. Inspect named source road/pad positions and a recorded steep location for exclusions. Preserve nearby road/building context in images.

Distant cache, zero cache, graph/type binding or Ground pixels alone never establish visible grass. inspect_near_view deliberately always returns visible_lit_grass_verified=false; task4 writes an independently reviewed image receipt.
persistence_and_regeneration: Record exact named material/type packages, map, emitted LayerInfo/Bake dependencies from ordinary lifecycle ledger; no Save All, no save_assets([]), no original/vendor normal saves.

Reopen each named map, then fresh editor process with exact source seal and new actual-PID lease. Read material parent, two corrected normal copies, four target names/weights and settings again; grass cache is transient and must repopulate near view.

Repeat ordinary current-area operation. Require stable four graph nodes/one GrassType/one area MI, no duplicate landscape or HDA copies, unchanged named mesh/material identities and correct scoped replacement. Cache instance counts are viewer-dependent; do not require literal persistence of HISM counts.
Record source implementation, native generation, nearby cache, Lit appearance, named save, same-map reopen, fresh-process reopen, repeated generation and user acceptance separately.
